text:
alex: Heads-up, noticed an uptick in fallback routing to v1 for a subset of customers after the v2 routing tweak earlier today. 5xxs are low but fallback_rate jumped to ~3.2% on eu-west-1.

mira: ugh. do we know the trigger? header mismatch, quota, or model incompat?

alex: initial signal shows missing x-rw-api-version headers from older SDKs + some client infra that strips unknown headers. runtime currently prefers header -> then implicit client-major -> then default v2. if header stripped, it falls through to implicit logic which for some UA patterns picks v1.

jonathan: can you paste the small snippet of the affinity logic?

alex: sure:
```
# simplified routing affinity
if req.headers.get('x-rw-api-version') == 'v2':
  route = 'v2'
elif req.headers.get('x-rw-api-version') == 'v1':
  route = 'v1'
elif req.headers.get('x-rw-client-major') == '1':
  route = 'v1'
else:
  route = 'v2'  # default
```

samir: so header strip + older UA -> picks v1. that explains it. impact on quotas? are those fallbacks charged against v1 quotas or v2?

mira: ops-logger: please confirm, but runtime currently consumes whichever route it routes to, so fallbacks count against v1 quota buckets. that will inflate v1 usage unexpectedly.

ops-logger: confirmed. observed ~12k tokens billed to v1 yesterday from the sampled client IDs flagged in the alert.

jonathan: two immediate risks: 1) customer surprise on billing, 2) correctness regressions if they intended v2 behaviour. We should mitigate quickly with minimal blast radius.

alex: proposal: 1) change runtime to prefer explicit header but fall back to a temporary 'graceful-v2' when header absent but UA ambiguous — i.e., assume v2 unless client explicitly matches known legacy list. 2) add a console toggle and per-customer sampling banner to make opt-outs easy. 3) add telemetry events: route_fallback.reason and route_fallback.final_route. 4) short canary deploy with 2% traffic then ramp.

mira: sounds reasonable. For (1) how do we maintain safety for customers pinned to v1? we need a held whitelist of customers that must keep v1 affinity.

samir: we already have `compat_exempt_customers` in tenant metadata. runtime can consult that. quick patch: invert default, consult whitelist, check explicit header first. Pseudocode:
```
if header present: use header
elif tenant in compat_exempt_customers: use v1
else: use v2
```

jonathan: add a runtime feature flag `runtime.routing.graceful_v2_default` so we can toggle without deploy. also emit metrics: `routing.fallback_rate`, `routing.fallback_by_tenant`, `routing.fallback_billed_tokens`. set alert if any tenant > 1% fallback for 30m.

alex: I'll open a small PR for the runtime change and enable feature flag off by default. Can someone draft console copy for the banner? needs to be explicit about billing and compatibility window.

mira: I'll do banner. Suggested copy: "Some SDKs omit our routing header. We will treat missing headers as v2 unless your account is whitelisted for legacy v1 support. If you need v1, visit Settings → API Versions to pin. Contact support for billing questions." short and to the point. :information_source:

console-bot: Draft banner posted to /console/drafts/2352.

samir: telemetry: add two counters and a sampled panic log with stack and request id when fallback occurs for a new tenant. We need to be able to tie token usage back to the original HTTP request id.

ops-logger: I'll add `request_id` to the fallback sampling payload. Also add a daily digest of top 20 tenants by fallback tokens.

alex: timeline: PR in next 60m, deploy to canary 2% in eu-west-1, monitor 15/30/60m windows. If any tenant >1% fallback or any >5% billing delta vs yesterday, rollback.

mira: +1. who owns customer comms if we need to contact multiple tenants?

samir: I'll own comms for customers with >0.5% fallback. Support and account execs on standby.

jonathan: one more ask: add a short migration-ux in console to show detected headerless SDKs per tenant and a one-click toggle to pin v1 for those customers. owners: product + console infra (mira + jonathan).

alex: noted. I'll include feature_flag usage in the PR and a metric `runtime.routing.override_used` when tenant uses console toggle.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch=runtime/graceful-v2, canary=eu-west-1(2%), started at 2154328000.

ops-logger: initial canary metrics at +10m: fallback_rate=0.9% (down from 3.2%), sampled fallbacks show same tenant pattern.

mira: great. keep an eye on billing counters and escalate if anything unexpected. I'll finish the banner and the console toggle stub today.

alex: thanks all — follow-ups: PR link, console draft link, weekly postmortem if we exceed thresholds.

jonathan: thumbs-up. :thumbsup:

samir: assigning follow-ups: samir -> customer comms, alex -> runtime PR, mira -> console banner & toggle, ops-logger -> fallback digest.

alex: adding checklist to PR and tagging infra on the rollback runbook.

mira: closing the thread here once deploy stabilizes, will ping.

alex: closing when canary passes.
